title: Personal Training Packages: what counts as a late cancellation and what happens to the session
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states what counts as a late cancellation of a scheduled coaching session and what determines whether one has occurred.

## Rule
Cancelling a scheduled session within the tier's own late-cancellation window, counted back in hours from the session's scheduled start, is a late cancellation. Cancelling with more notice than that window returns no charge and does not touch the package's session balance. The basis for whether a given cancellation falls inside the window is the member's stated notice, matched against the session time on file with the front desk.

~~forfeits the session from the package balance and charges the tier's own flat late-cancellation fee~~ This clause is no longer in force for what a late cancellation forfeits and charges; the current basis for the amount charged on a late cancellation is stated in the logging-a-late-cancellation-charge and corporate-wellness-discount-on-the-late-cancellation-fee documents for this product.

## Points of judgement
- If the member's stated cancellation notice, matched against the session time on file, falls within the tier's own late-cancellation window, the cancellation is a late cancellation.
- If the member's stated notice falls outside that window (earlier than the window's start), the cancellation is not a late cancellation, no charge is returned, and the package's session balance is not touched.
The front-desk-recorded session time is the record against which the member's stated notice is matched; a cancellation is judged against the specific session it concerns, not against any other session on the same package.
